result.title: Probing and Steering for Safety-Relevant Behaviours in Large Language Models
result.comment: 20 pages, 26 figures, 11 tables. Code, data and interactive interface: https://github.com/NimunB/probing-safety-behaviours
result.summary: Activation probes are computed directions in a language model's residual stream, used both to detect safety-relevant behaviours and, by adding their direction back into the stream, to steer them. We explore how the main design choices behind such probes interact, within one pipeline, on one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and across three behaviours: deception, high-stakes awareness and sycophancy. The pipeline crosses two estimators (difference-of-means and logistic regression) with three token-pooling schemes (last, mean and learned attention), selects appropriate layers to detect or steer a behaviour, and evaluates every direction twice: as a detector of the behaviour, and as a steering vector to push outputs towards the behaviour. Prior work read together suggests a read/write dissociation, in which logistic regression reads (detects) best but difference-of-means directions write (steer) best. We find that it holds for deception and high-stakes but not for sycophancy, where the pattern reverses. The reversal appears to follow partially from the data rather than from the estimators. The best pooling technique and the layer choice depend on the behaviour and data, and the layer that steers best can sit well before the layer that detects best. The right steering metric to use between changing a model's perception and eliciting behaviour depends on the task - and the two can disagree outright. The exported probes and directions power an interactive interface through which a user can score and steer text directly.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上把激活探针的两种估计器（均值差、逻辑回归）与三种 token 池化方式系统交叉，为欺骗、高风险意识、谄媚三种行为选层，并在「检测」与「引导」两种用法下评估同一方向，发现读/写分离只在部分行为上成立。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可读出」与「可因果引导」双重评估、以及引导层可早于检测层的发现，可供核查 LVR 内部状态究竟是仅可解码还是真正参与答案生成，池化与层选择线索也可能迁移到 latent 相似度分析；跨任务与跨模态的适用性仍需验证。
